[1/3] Plan: route NPC radar names through the label collision map

impact_assessment.why: NPC captain names were painted after body labels and could overlap them, making both unreadable at deterministic radar frames.
impact_assessment.benefits: NPC names avoid body/flagship labels, remain clickable, and selected names are forced visible.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none (canvas-only); regression: unselected NPC names may drop on a crowded map.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Static contract test, frozen-clock before/after captures, real marker click, vision review.

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: persist the SOUND FX toggle and mute the master gain immediately

impact_assessment.why: The top-bar SOUND FX toggle flips sound.enabled but never saves settings or lowers the master gain, so a reload restores audio and any already-playing cue continues after MUTE.
impact_assessment.benefits: Mute survives reload, the settings panel and top bar agree, and the master gain silences current and future voices.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none; concurrency: AudioContext creation stays on the first user gesture; state: existing localStorage key, no save schema.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Real browser mute/reload/unmute play with master-gain assertions, static contract test, before/after reload captures.

[1/2] Plan: fire the unused level-up cue when Pilot Mastery rises

impact_assessment.why: SoundController.playLevelUp() is defined but never called; promotions render a log and a new LVL badge in silence, so a competence milestone lacks its audio cue.
impact_assessment.benefits: Pilot promotions gain the synthesized level-up sound; loaded saves do not spill a false cue.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none; concurrency: renderHUD stays synchronous; state: one in-memory last-level tracker, no save field.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Instrumented real browser play crossing level 1->2, static contract test, initial-render guard.

Task 'voidfarer-cycle8-levelup-cue' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: distinguish Commander and Pilot Mastery tracks in the PLAYER card

impact_assessment.why: The PLAYER card labels the Commander track LEVEL/XP while the HUD labels the separate Pilot Mastery track LVL/XP; after a mastery promotion the card still reads LEVEL 1 0/400, which looks stale even though both values are correct.
impact_assessment.benefits: Players see both progression tracks and their separate currencies (SP vs talent points) in one place; a promotion no longer looks like a missed update.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none; concurrency: renderPlayer stays synchronous; state: read-only from existing character/mastery fields.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Static label test, same promotion play capturing both tracks, vision review, no game-logic change.

[1/2] Plan: normalize legacy landable flags on load from one shared surface-type set

impact_assessment.why: Existing saves persist landable=false for gas/lava worlds, so they cannot use the operations unlocked in Cycle 5; generation and migration also duplicated the landable policy.
impact_assessment.benefits: Legacy saves gain LAND ON SURFACE, Cloud Scoop and Magma Tap on load without rewriting ownership or population; one policy constant.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: galaxy imports surface (no cycle); concurrency: constructor migration under existing load path; state: only the persisted landable boolean changes.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Legacy 474KB save play, ownership/government assertions, before/after target-card captures.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: pay the landing survey reward once per body and persist surveyed bodies

impact_assessment.why: land_on_body awards 150 + radius/1000*5 credits on every landing; a ringed giant pays +450 cr each time, so leave-and-reland farms credits indefinitely.
impact_assessment.benefits: Survey rewards become a real one-time discovery while repeat landings still open surface operations; old saves remain loadable.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ShipState gains one additive tuple (old saves default empty); dependency: none; concurrency: engine lock held; state: surveyed set grows one id per body.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first engine test, save round-trip/default test, before/after scripted land-travel-land run, full suite.
